title: Don't use the build compiler check in case LLVM backend is used.

timeline.message:
Don't use the build compiler check in case LLVM backend is used.
This fixes #2166
timeline.author: Johan Vos

timeline.body: The LLVM backend still relies on the native compiler in the general case though, I'd make the check dependent on ExitAfterRelocatableImageWrite instead.
@johanvos can you check that omitting the check only when `ExitAfterRelocatableImageWrite` is on solves your problem?

timeline.message: Don't skip verifyCompiler unless -H:+ExitAfterRelocatableImageWrite is set (and LLVM backend is used)
timeline.author: Johan Vos

timeline.body: yes, that works. I added a commit so that the verify is only skipped in case the LLVMBackend is user AND -H:+ExitAfterRelocatableImageWrite is set.

reply.body: we use pre-generated CAP files and CAPcache for cross-platform targets, so there is no compiler needed.
